item.title: 🔵 Unlocking the Cloudflare app ecosystem with OAuth for all
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Self-Managed OAuth is now available to all developers on Cloudflare. Here's how we executed a zero-downtime migration of our core OAuth engine to make it happen.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 18h ago

item.title: 🔵 The post-quantum EO is an important milestone. Now it’s time to get to work
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality system impact — check guest-facing services and PMS/POS status.
The new post-quantum executive order sets a 2030 migration deadline and establishes a powerful foundation for post-quantum resilience. We look at what it gets right, where it can go further, and our migration playbook for government and industry.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 1d ago

item.title: 🔵 How we found a bug in the hyper HTTP library
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
By rearchitecting the Images binding, we accidentally uncovered a bug that existed in the open-source hyper library across multiple major versions.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago
